purpose: Measure saved V3 repeat variation versus saved V3/V4 discrepancy on the complete real graph; retain the original failure and arithmetic threshold.

preserved_failure.condition: Qualified arithmetic mismatch checkpoint next model F1.0.decoder.xcnlin.ops.3.weight
preserved_failure.observed_passes_before_failure: All J comparisons and J extra probes completed. At F first update, forward and all gradient comparisons passed before next-model comparison failed. F Adam/support/RNG comparison results are not established.
preserved_failure.source_inference_basis: checkpoint_parity.trajectory evaluates both actual_step calls before returning; J reference/candidate and F reference/candidate trajectories returned before the first F next-model comparator raised.

source_diagnosis.checkpoint_change: V4 wraps the same auxiliary depth_zero call in nonreentrant checkpoint with early_stop=False, preserve_rng_state=True, explicit arguments and determinism_check=default; V3 calls depth_zero directly. Constructor/native optimizer/main detach boundary sources remain pinned.
source_diagnosis.kernel_variation_evidence: Prototype SharedEncoder.forward has two index_add accumulations; graph_ops.feature_sum also uses index_add. Qualified CUDA runtime has deterministic_algorithms=False. These are plausible accumulation-variation sites, not evidence of the measured cause.
source_diagnosis.Adam_sensitivity_argument: For a fresh Adam slot with weight_decay=0, the first update is proportional to lr*g/(abs(g)+eps), ignoring native rounding. Around g=0 its local slope is lr/eps; decoder lr=0.0037 and expected native eps=1e-8 imply slope up to 370000. A gradient comparison within atol=1.52587890625e-5 therefore does not imply next-model agreement. Current failure contains no gradient magnitude evidence.
source_diagnosis.checkpoint_metadata_check_limit: PyTorch checkpoint determinism_check=default checks saved/recomputed tensor metadata; it does not establish full tensor value equality.

diagnostic_receipt_contents.conditioning: Per named parameter: exact Adam group/slot, eps/lr, absolute gradient <= eps counts, nonzero sign differences, bias-corrected denominator <= 2*eps counts, derived Adam-direction max difference. Descriptive counts do not modify the arithmetic gate.
diagnostic_receipt_contents.exact_state: Full Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/all-visible-CUDA RNG component hashes and exact equality before forward, after forward, after backward and after update; full module training flag maps and exact support digests.
diagnostic_receipt_contents.runtime: Exact actual Torch/CUDA/default dtype/determinism/TF32/matmul/autocast/cuDNN flags and relevant CUDA environment values before/after; qualified profile required and flags are not changed by the diagnostic.

diagnostic_receipt_contents.output_only: Atomic JSON-compatible scalar summaries and hashes through a separately admitted runner callback; no raw prediction, tensor state or RNG payload serialization.

diagnostic_step_differences_from_sealed_.math_and_call_order: Same batch_forward, detach autograd probe, selected auxiliary, main+auxiliary, forward_image, backward, finite checks, gradient_image, native optimizer.step and snapshot helpers.
diagnostic_step_differences_from_sealed_.measurement_only: Captures after-backward RNG, journals completed optimizer calls, summarizes all discrepancies without fail-fast on arithmetic mismatch. Backward RNG differences are recorded, not relabeled as qualified equality.
diagnostic_step_differences_from_sealed_.limitation: A hard-guard failure stops remaining work and records a diagnostic failure with partial counts; arithmetic differences alone do not stop comparisons.

interpretation_rules: If V3 repeat differences are comparable to V3/V4 differences, native accumulation variation and Adam sensitivity remain plausible; this does not prove checkpoint parity.
If V3 repeat is stable while V3/V4 differs more, investigate checkpoint-specific recomputation and scheduling; one repeat cannot prove attribution or rule out schedule-dependent CUDA variation.
No prospective diagnostic can overwrite the failed qualification, weaken tolerance, provide fit admission or establish a scientific resource-cap verdict.
